title: A Tale of Two Clone Shells

entities.name: Trennet
entities.description: An ambitious vedalken mage who volunteers to free Research Spire Eleven from the Phyrexians and plans to hide inside his clone shell to dominate his rival's beast.

entities.name: Sarja
entities.description: A Neurok woman who competes with Trennet for Research Spire Eleven and tricks him with a clone shell imprinted with another clone shell.

entities.name: Politus
entities.description: The vedalken leader who offers ownership of Research Spire Eleven to whoever frees it from the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders of infectious necrometalloids, including infected seastriders, thrummingbirds and a drake-lord, who attack the spires.

entities.name: Phyrexian drake-lord
entities.description: A massive Phyrexianized winged creature with an exposed black metal endoskeleton; Trennet dominates it briefly and Sarja kills it.

entities.name: Clone shell
entities.description: A quantity of quasi-living quicksilver that moves as a humanoid and transforms into any creature imprinted on it, or conceals one inside.

entities.name: Research Spire Eleven
entities.description: A vedalken spire over the Quicksilver Sea seized by Phyrexians and won by Sarja.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: The sea in which the vedalken spires stand.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: A vedalken locale from which Trennet and Sarja depart; its shapers heal Trennet.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: The blue-skinned understated mage-race of which Trennet and Politus are members.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: The human faction of which Sarja is a member, with whom the vedalken fought a battle and truce.

entities.name: Knowledge Pool
entities.description: A vedalken resource suffering incalculable damage from the Phyrexian attacks.

events.summary: Trennet watches a spire collapse to the Phyrexians and, wanting the power he was promised, volunteers to free Research Spire Eleven.
Trennet meets his only rival, the Neurok woman Sarja, who mocks him.
Trennet notices Sarja carrying a clone shell of her own and guesses she plans to unleash a hellkite on the Phyrexians.
events.quote: She would drop the clone shell near the Spire, wait until the Phyrexians mangled its humanoid form

events.summary: Trennet resolves to hide himself inside his own clone shell and dominate Sarja's beast once it appears.
events.quote: He would hide within his own clone shell

events.summary: Trennet climbs the Spire from inside his clone shell and sees the Phyrexian attackers and Sarja's shell.
events.quote: They tore at the structure of the Spire

events.summary: A Phyrexianized seastrider knocks Sarja's shell off the platform, and the Phyrexians then turn on Trennet's shell.
events.quote: The shell fell off the platform, plummeting into empty space.

events.summary: The drake-lord knocks Trennet's shell off the crosspiece onto the same platform as Sarja's shell.
events.quote: His clone shell lost its balance and fell from the crosspiece.

events.summary: Trennet attacks Sarja's clone shell to force it to transform, but it only reforms as a humanoid because it is imprinted with another clone shell.
events.quote: It was that Sarja's clone shell had been imprinted with— another clone shell .

events.summary: A Phyrexian shreds Trennet's shell, leaving him exposed; he casts magic at the Phyrexians and hides behind Sarja's shell.
events.quote: He wasted no time, and hurled magic at the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Each time the Phyrexians destroy Sarja's shell another humanoid shell emerges; Trennet tears at it and finds only more shells.
events.quote: all he found underneath was more clone shells.

events.summary: Trennet dominates the drake-lord's mind and turns it against the other Phyrexians, destroying them.
events.quote: It worked. He now commanded the huge Phyrexian beast.

events.summary: Trennet's spell fails and the drake-lord seizes and crushes him.
events.quote: But Trennet had no more power to hold onto its will.

events.summary: Sarja emerges from her last clone shell and kills the drake-lord with a dagger.
events.quote: she leapt onto the drake's back and sank the dagger into its spine.

events.summary: Sarja demands the Spire as the price for freeing Trennet, and he concedes.
events.quote: "Concede the Spire to me, and I will," Sarja said

events.summary: Trennet is healed by Lumengrid shapers, the Spire is rebuilt, and Sarja holds it with a patrol of clone shells; Trennet considers Research Spire Sixteen instead.
events.quote: Maybe he should try to reclaim Research Spire Sixteen, instead.

relations.quote: What he didn't count on was competition. Human competition.
the vedalken leader Politus asked for volunteers to free Research Spire Eleven
Trennet was an ambitious mage even for his species.
The only other volunteer was Sarja, a Neurok woman.

relations.note: The Phyrexians attack the vedalken spires.
relations.quote: the Phyrexians were becoming a problem.
until the drake-thing's head snapped free of its vertebrae

relations.note: The spire stands over the sea.
relations.quote: The Spire swayed above the Sea
